release_notes:
1. Separated view_search_results and view_item_list events strictly by actual user actions.
2. Eliminated consecutive dual-event firing on search pages; only view_search_results fires on search actions.
3. Preserved view_item_list strictly for genuine product listings (Category, Home Featured, Brand, On Sale, New Products, Best Sellers) with authentic list IDs and names.
4. Cleaned up synthetic item_list_id ('search_results') and item_list_name ('Search: <term>') parameters.
